facts.fact: The World Bank's 8-12 September 2025 mission to the STP Digital project saw live demonstrations of functional prototypes of the interoperability and data-exchange platform (DEX), being designed and implemented by the System Integrator Ooru with INIC and DGRN, with integration of the interoperability layer with the verifiable credentials infrastructure planned for March 2026.

systems.owner: INIC and DGRN, with System Integrator Ooru
